critical_findings.claim: The physical deposit and the Stored/code/SMS steps have no failure boundary.
Expired has no exit and expiry never frees the compartment.
Recipient-only opening conflicts with operator service opening.
A daily sweep cannot enforce an exact 72-hour pickup window.
The retry sequence ends without a terminal failure action.
Offline operation leaves code generation and source-of-truth ownership unstated.
A six-digit code does not enforce the stated recipient identity rule.

must_not_claim.reason: The fixture supplies prose and no running system or code.
The fixture explicitly describes a fictional company.
